A Shadow-Cursed Vine Blight is a blight Plant creature found in the Shadow-Cursed Lands in Act Two.

Overview

Shadow-Cursed Vine Blights, like its brethren the Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound and the Shadow-Cursed Needle Blight, conceal themselves within the surrounding vegetation in order to ambush passersby. The party must pass a  DC 30 Perception Check to spot these ambush parties and avoid being surprised.

Combat

During the Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound fight, blights heavily prioritize using their restraining abilities. Since the Shambling Mound can instantly kill a restrained target with  Devour, getting restrained can be deadly. As a result, if a party member is targeted by  Constrict, breaking free should be prioritized.

This can be done by breaking the blight's concentration. Blights have a fairly low Constitution modifier of +2, so breaking concentration with damage can be fairly reliable. Allies can also be freed from their restraints by spending an action using  Help.

Features like  Land's Stride: Plants and  Freedom of Movement prevent being restrained and make blights far less dangerous.

Immunities

Shadow-Cursed Vine Blights are immune to the following conditions:

  • All conditions under  Blinded
  •  Bleeding

  •  Entangled

  •  Shadow-Cursed Vines
